title: Enforcement — mockups to schema
subtitle: Each screen · the fields it reads · the rule · what enforces it

sections.title: How to read this deck
sections.body:
Each page is one screen. Numbered markers ① ② … sit on the mockup; the table under it says, per marker:

- **reads**: the schema fields that produce it
- **rule**: the kernel it relies on (below)
- **enforced by**: what makes the rule true, so the screen can't lie

| Rule | Says | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|
| **R1** | every restriction has a reason and a decider | NOT NULL + CHECK in the table; `restrict()` takes a typed category from the registry (tsc) |
| **R2** | the remedy matches the finding | `lift()` takes one restriction id — no API lifts "a domain"; allowance CHECK: exactly one selector |
| **R3** | detectors provisional, people binding | lift fields all-or-none CHECK; `liftedBy` is a User FK; `lift()` only reachable from an admin route (structure test); allowance `until` required + capped |
| **R4** | write once, compute everything else | rows immutable except lift/uphold fields (trigger); only `models/restriction.ts` imports the `disabled` writers (structure test); nightly `disabled` ⇔ `check()` comparison |
| **R5** | evidence explains, never decides | `check()` takes restrictions only — evidence isn't a parameter, so it can't be consulted |

sections.title: The schema, with its enforcement inline
sections.body:
```sql
CREATE TABLE "Restriction" (
  id              text PRIMARY KEY,
  "teamId"        text NOT NULL REFERENCES "Team",
  scope           text NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('team','sendingDomain','email')),
  "sendingDomainId" text REFERENCES "SendingDomain",
  "emailMessageId"  text REFERENCES "EmailMessage",
  effect          text NOT NULL CHECK (effect IN ('send','publish')),
  category        text NOT NULL,                 -- R1; values checked by the registry type
  "ruleId"        text,
  "findingKey"    text,
  "decidedBy"     text NOT NULL,                 -- R1: 'automation@<rule>-v<n>' or a user id
  note            text,
  "createdAt"     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "upheldBy"      text REFERENCES "User",
  "upheldAt"      timestamptz,
  "liftedBy"      text REFERENCES "User",        -- R3: a person, never automation
  "liftedAt"      timestamptz,
  verdict         text CHECK (verdict IN ('wrong','fixed','reclassified')),
  "liftNote"      text,

  -- the target matches the scope
  CHECK ((scope = 'team'          AND "sendingDomainId" IS NULL     AND "emailMessageId" IS NULL)
      OR (scope = 'sendingDomain' AND "sendingDomainId" IS NOT NULL AND "emailMessageId" IS NULL)
      OR (scope = 'email'         AND "emailMessageId"  IS NOT NULL)),
  -- R1: a detector names its rule; a person writes a note
  CHECK (("decidedBy" LIKE 'automation@%' AND "ruleId" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("decidedBy" NOT LIKE 'automation@%' AND note IS NOT NULL)),
  -- R3: a lift is a person, a verdict and a note, all at once
  CHECK (num_nonnulls("liftedBy","liftedAt",verdict,"liftNote") IN (0, 4)),
  CHECK (num_nonnulls("upheldBy","upheldAt") IN (0, 2) OR category = 'legacy.unrecorded'),
  CHECK (verdict IS DISTINCT FROM 'reclassified' OR category = 'legacy.unrecorded')
);

-- R4: written once. Only the uphold and lift fields may change, each only once; no deletes.
CREATE TRIGGER restriction_write_once BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "Restriction" …;

CREATE INDEX ON "Restriction" ("sendingDomainId") WHERE "liftedAt" IS NULL;  -- what blocks, fast
CREATE INDEX ON "Restriction" ("teamId")          WHERE "liftedAt" IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE "RestrictionEvidence" (
  "restrictionId" text NOT NULL REFERENCES "Restriction",
  kind  text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('notice','email','suspiciousActivity','adminInteraction','url')),
  ref   text NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE "Allowance" (
  id text PRIMARY KEY, "teamId" text NOT NULL REFERENCES "Team",
  "findingKey" text, "ruleId" text, category text,
  CHECK (num_nonnulls("findingKey","ruleId",category) = 1),        -- R2: one selector
  "grantedBy" text NOT NULL REFERENCES "User",                      -- R3: a person
  "until" timestamptz NOT NULL, note text NOT NULL,
  CHECK ("until" <= "createdAt" + interval '180 days'),             -- R3: expires
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "revokedBy" text REFERENCES "User", "revokedAt" timestamptz
);
```
`SendingDomain.disabled` stays as a cached copy; R4's code and nightly check keep it equal to `check()`.

sections.title: Reviewer · what keeps this blocked
sections.body:
```
admin › team › acme                                    mail.acme-example.com
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ① ■ Can't send — 2 reasons. Lifting both re-enables.                      │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ② Possible phishing · "Reset your password"   ③ waiting   [Uphold][Lift…] │
│ ④ email · send · automation@scan-v14 · Oct 28 14:07                       │
│ ⑤ Evidence: AI verdict · the email ↗                                      │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ② Complaint rate 0.41% over 24h               ③ waiting   [Uphold][Lift…] │
│ ④ domain · send · automation@health-v3 · Oct 28 15:52                     │
│ ⑤ Evidence: Spam notice at Error ↗                                        │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ⑥ ░ Banned word "bitcoin" · lifted · Dana R. · wrong · allowed to Jan 27  │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
| | reads | rule | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① | `check({action:"send", target: domain})` → `blocking.length` | R4, R5 | `check()` is the only definition; it takes restrictions only |
| ② | registry text for `category` + `findingKey` | R1 | `category` NOT NULL; registry type at the `restrict()` call |
| ③ | `upheldAt` null → waiting, set → confirmed | R3 | uphold pair CHECK; `uphold()` needs an admin user |
| ④ | `scope`, `effect`, `decidedBy`, `createdAt` | R1 | `decidedBy` NOT NULL; detector ⇒ `ruleId` CHECK |
| ⑤ | `RestrictionEvidence` rows (kind, ref) | R5 | shown, never passed to `check()` |
| ⑥ | `liftedBy/At`, `verdict`, `liftNote` + its Allowance | R2, R3 | lift all-or-none CHECK; allowance one-selector + `until` CHECKs |

sections.title: Reviewer · lift one reason
sections.body:
```
Lift: Possible phishing · "Reset your password"

  ① (●) The check was wrong      ( ) The sender fixed it
  ② [✓] Don't flag this email again until [ Jan 27 ]
  ③ Note ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
         │ Their own app's reset email, links to them. │
         └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                          [Cancel] [Lift]
after:
  ④ ■ Can't send — 1 reason left.  Complaint rate 0.41%…
  ⑤ toast: "Lifted. mail.acme still can't send: complaint rate (Oct 28 15:52)."
```
| | writes / reads | rule | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① | writes `verdict` | R3 | CHECK verdict ∈ {wrong, fixed}; all four lift fields or none |
| ② | writes an Allowance: `findingKey = email:<id>`, `until` | R2, R3 | one-selector CHECK; `until` NOT NULL, ≤ 180 days |
| ③ | writes `liftNote`; `liftedBy` = the session user | R3 | `liftedBy` FK to User; `lift()` only behind an admin route (structure test) |
| ④ | `check()` after the write | R2, R4 | `lift()` takes one restriction id; `disabled` is recomputed from `check()` in the same transaction |
| ⑤ | the remaining `blocking` rows | R2 | nothing can lift "the domain", so the other reason survives |

sections.title: Admin · block by hand
sections.body:
```
Block acme
  ① Applies to  ( ) Team  (●) mail.acme-example.com  ( ) One email…
  ② Stops       (●) Sending  ( ) Publishing
  ③ Reason      [ Purchased or scraped list ▾ ]
  ④ Evidence    ☑ Spam complaints at Error · Oct 28 15:52
                + Link  https://support…/thread/8812
  ⑤ Note        [ Replied to support admitting a bought list. ]
                                          [Cancel] [Block]
```
| | writes | rule | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① | `scope` + `sendingDomainId` / `emailMessageId` | — | scope/target CHECK |
| ② | `effect` | — | CHECK effect ∈ {send, publish} |
| ③ | `category` (and the registry's sender text) | R1 | registry type at `restrict()`; NOT NULL |
| ④ | `RestrictionEvidence` (notice id, url) | R5 | its own table; never read by `check()` |
| ⑤ | `note`, `decidedBy` = the admin | R1 | person ⇒ note CHECK |

sections.title: Sender · banner and API
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ⚠ ① Sending from mail.acme-example.com is paused            │
│   ② One of your emails looked like phishing to our checks.  │
│   ③ We're reviewing it; we'll email you by end of next      │
│     business day.                                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
POST /api/v1/transactional → 403
{ "reason": { "category": "content.phishing",  ②
              "summary": "An email looked like phishing…",
              "next": "under_review" } }          ③
```
| | reads | rule | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① | `check({action:"send"})` for the domain | R4 | same function as the reviewer's header |
| ② | `category` → registry's sender text (never `note`) | R1 | the sender view selects registry text only; notes have no path to it |
| ③ | `upheldAt` null → "under review"; set → "confirmed" | R3 | uphold pair CHECK |

sections.title: Holding one email or one publish
sections.body:
```
Workflow › Onboarding › Email 3
  ① ⏸ This email is held for review — it won't send.
  ② The rest of your workflow keeps running.

Campaign "Black Friday" → [Publish]
  ③ ⏸ Publishing is held for review. Your edits are saved.
```
| | reads | rule | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① | restriction `scope = email`, `effect = send`, `emailMessageId` | R2 | scope/target CHECK; `check()` coverage: an email restriction covers only that email |
| ② | no team/domain restriction in `blocking` | R2 | `covers()` — a narrower scope never blocks a wider target |
| ③ | `scope = email`, `effect = publish` (LOO-6309) | R2 | same table, same lift |

sections.title: Timeline · computed, never written
sections.body:
```
① Oct 27 09:12  Restricted  banned word "bitcoin"   automation@banned-words-v2
② Oct 27 11:40  Lifted      wrong · Dana R. · allowed until Jan 27
① Oct 28 14:07  Restricted  possible phishing        automation@scan-v14
① Oct 28 15:52  Restricted  complaint rate 0.41%     automation@health-v3
③ Oct 28 15:52  → can't send (2 reasons)
```
| | reads | rule | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① | each row's `createdAt`, `category`, `decidedBy` | R4 | write-once trigger: a past row can't be edited, so history can't be rewritten |
| ② | `liftedAt`, `verdict`, `liftedBy`, Allowance | R3 | lift fields set once (trigger) |
| ③ | `stateAt(rows, t)` at each event | R4 | pure function over the same rows; no stored timeline |

sections.title: Dashboard · the fleet
sections.body:
```
┌──────────────┬──────────────┬──────────────┬──────────────┐
│① Blocked now │② Waiting     │③ Unexplained │④ Lifted as   │
│ 412 domains  │ 37 · oldest  │ 1,204 legacy │ wrong: 18%   │
│  38 teams    │ 3d 4h        │ ↓ 96 this wk │ ↑ from 11%   │
└──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┘
⑤ Waiting for review, oldest first
  3d 4h  acme-mail.com   content.phishing   scan-v14   2 evidence  →
```
| | reads | rule | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① | distinct targets with `liftedAt IS NULL` | R4 | same rows `check()` reads; the partial index |
| ② | `liftedAt IS NULL AND upheldAt IS NULL`, min(`createdAt`) | R3 | uphold/lift CHECKs make "waiting" well-defined |
| ③ | `category = 'legacy.unrecorded' AND liftedAt IS NULL` | R1, R4 | after step 3 every write has a real category, so this only falls; an increase means a write bypassed `restrict()` — the nightly check names it |
| ④ | `verdict = 'wrong'` / decided, this window vs last | R3 | verdict CHECK; only people lift |
| ⑤ | waiting rows + `count(RestrictionEvidence)` | R5 | evidence counted, never decisive |

sections.title: Dashboard · detector scorecards
sections.body:
```
Detectors                  blocks  upheld  wrong  fixed  waiting  to decide
① scan-v14 (phishing)          41     22     12      3        4   9h
① scan-v13                     55     25     24 ⚠    2        0  14h
  health-v3 (complaints)       88     70      4     11        3   5h
② signup-review (people)       64     64      —      —        0    —
```
| | reads | rule | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① | group by `ruleId` + the version in `decidedBy`; count by `upheldAt` / `verdict` | R1, R3 | detectors must write `ruleId` (CHECK) and a versioned `decidedBy`; only people set verdicts |
| ② | `decidedBy` is a user → no wrong/fixed column | R3 | people are binding: their blocks are upheld by definition, so the scorecard measures detectors only |

This page is the reason R3 records a verdict at all: without it, a detector's false-positive rate is unknowable.

sections.title: Enforcement in code: four checks that fail loudly
sections.body:
1. **Types (tsc).** `restrict({ category: RegistryCategory, … })` — a category not in the registry doesn't compile. `check(restrictions, target, at)` has no evidence parameter (R5).
2. **One door (structure test).** The queries that write `SendingDomain.disabled` and the Restriction lift/uphold columns are imported only by `models/restriction.ts`; `lift`/`uphold` only by admin routes. A test walks the import graph and fails on any other importer (R3, R4).
3. **The database.** The CHECKs and the write-once trigger on the schema page: a bad row can't be written even by SQL by hand (R1–R4).
4. **The nightly check.** For every domain: `disabled === (check(...).blocking.length > 0)`. A mismatch alerts with the domain id — the only thing that catches a write from outside the code (a console, a script) (R4).

Tests per rule live beside the model: lift one of two → still blocked (R2); a detector restriction without `ruleId` throws at insert (R1); a second lift on one row is rejected (R4); `check()` ignores an evidence-only change (R5).
